name: yogatik
description: Yogatik Studio — Standalone Unrestricted AI Agentic Assistant & Desktop Environment. The application lives in frontend/ — see CLAUDE.md.
//: THE APP IS frontend/. This file used to drive a pnpm monorepo (@my-app/web-app, @my-app/shared-ui, @my-app/desktop-electron) that was an abandoned hello-world scaffold — apps/web-app/src/App.tsx was a Card with a 'Get Started' button. Because the root package.json named it and a placeholder src/ sat beside it, an automated audit read the scaffold as the product and reported that Yogatik had no chat UI, no provider switcher and no tool calling — all of which have shipped in frontend/ for months. The scaffold was deleted on 2026-08-31. Every script below now delegates to frontend/ so the root cannot point anywhere else again.
